title: The top ten by what it was and when it landed
subtitle: The ten scored priorities, cross-tabulated by the category each carried and the release that eventually took it.
note: Eight of the ten were compliance items. That is the shape of the finding: the platform was not short of features, it was short of a compliance layer people could actually work inside.
source: Top ten prioritisation and release plan, Time and Attendance Findings Report, October 2024.
